book.name: EFESO
book.title: Efeso wedi Leta Pol wana Luluweli

content: Humiu Helak he-nanatune nunuwaneine, iyete hu hamnohon humiu gen sohode iye.
Nunuwane pageine gen hu edodogan-an, sohode Keriso i nunuwane-yanide. Iye i taeman yawedine hide kaiwade sohode powo bwabwalaiine gane Helak i yariyae-yan.
Ganawal pageine ge page mwadmwadineine, ge tomemek pageine, tab tankai hotiya i egan heimiu. Page henebwaden yake humiu Helak wana bobode gagabubidiye taine bosowaimiu sohode.
Sohode hedi, tab papabek, tab gogobwage suwok, ge tab ganawal dotetiine hu elihuyan, kaiwane taine i dedohob-anmiu. Age hu lihuyan gomulolu egene Helak heine.

Nuwamiu i sapu te hebwaden si eginginawi ganawal pageine ge page mwadmwadineine ge hebwaden si tomemek, taine habadiye i degan Keriso ge Helak he wedi bagalogugui hei. (Tomemek pageine te sohode ta kukululu lok helak yoyokapisine heine.)
Iyete tab tolomo hotiya wana lihu yoyokapisine hei ge i egohowo nuwamiu. Page denan yake kaiwadiye Helak wana huge bwele i luwom bobode hebwaden taine si delonge halingane heidiye.
Iyete tab hene-bwaimiu bobode sosohode-yan yake hu epebwange.
Veto hu emiye he gogou, age sauge ya Guyau heine hu miye he wayae.
ge hu luweni sahe gane Guyau i yariyae-an iloke gen hu lapu. Kaiwane wayae hinone iye te page dodohobine, page sapusapuine ge gotolosuwok.
Tab hu eselok gogou pageine hana ginginawi hei, kaiwane taine hinone i degan, age hu payoumateid he wayae ge bobode si lapu gegi ti yake.
(Gane bobode si ginawi sumwan taine bosowaiu a degotagan, a mwadine-yan hana lihulihu.)
Bigi bwabwaligadiye hebwaden ta payoumateid he wayae, hobak ta paidiid vetahe,
kaiwane wayae iye i hotei taganid bigi bwabwaligane ge ta paidi vetahe. Iye te kaiwane wada lihu hotiya i nga:
Yawedimiu hana dodogan hu matahasik vetahe. Gen humiu sohode hebwaden tonuwosapu, tab humiu sohode hebwaden taine nuwadiye i desapu.
Tab lemi sauge dodohobine hotiya hu epasibaleno-yan, kaiwane sauge ya ngak hana ginginawi hobak i gaisi.
Tab hu eboliboli, agegene gen nuwamiu i sapu-yan Guyau wana nuwotu kaiwamiu.
Tab hu emun kabaleya-yan bwai gaigaisiine, hebe hoge i bagapangekmiu. Agegene hu susuwoku-yan Yayaluwo Gagabubine.
Gen hu lihu-yan sam, wok tapwalolo ge wok hebwaden Yayaluwo Gagabubine wana giyau hedi lihulihu hene-bwaimiu heidiye. Gen hu wok tobal Guyau heine he hawamiu ge he hatiyemiu hedi,
ge wada Guyau Yeisu Keriso he hidane hei, sauge hohoyowate hu egomulolu Helak Tamade heine bigi bwabwaligane kaiwadiye.
Mehaduwe Venakau ge Bobode Lihuidiye
Gen hu senapuyan he-bwaimiu wedi logugui Keriso hana hawatau kaiwane.
Humiu mehaduwe venakau, gen hu senapuyan he-mwamwaniyemiu wedi logugui sohode hu senapuyan Guyau wana logugui.
Kaiwane tolomo iye poniyene hulune sohode te Keriso iye ekelesiya hulune. Ekelesiya iye Keriso tuwane, ge Keriso iye ekelesiya hana Topamwad.
Ekelesiya i senapuyan Keriso wana logugui, sohode hedi mehaduwe venakau gen si senapuyan he-mwamwaniyediye wedi logugui sauge hoyowate.
Humiu mehaduwe bobode, gen hu nunuwane-yanid he-ponponiyemiu sohode Keriso i nunuwane-yan ekelesiya ge i taeman yawedine kaiwane.
Yawedine i taeman nuwane i sawi pakanekane-id togoru-yan he bwai
sohode Wase Dodohobine hana lihu. Keriso nuwane i pagabub ekelesiya,
ge i pamidi he matane sohode ekelesiya gane hana hao dodohobine suwok, taine hana pupuwok, taine tuwane i debaluli, ge taine ngakine hotiya hedi, agegene i sapusapu ge taine wana ngak i degan.
Sohode hedi ti yo, bobode gen si nunuwane-yanid he-ponponiyediye sohode si nunuwane-yan totodiye tuwadiye giniteine denan. Hebe tolomo i nunuwane-yan poniyene, sohode hedi i nunuwane-yan totone.
Taine sauge hotiya tolomo hotiya i edehuge-yan totone tuwane. Agegene i pahan ge i matahasik vetahe, sohode Keriso i ginawi hide ekelesiya heide,
kaiwane hide iye tuwane giniteine denan.
Buk Bwabwalene i liwo, “Iye te kaiwane tolomo gen i miyokid tamane ge tinane i la bwaine ge poniyene si mipase iloke si toiwo si tabwa tutuwo hotaege.”
Buk yake hana nunuwotu i malemale suwok. Nau a lihu lok Keriso bwaine ekelesiya heidiye.
Age hana lihulihu i lowo hedi humiu heimiu. Iloke tolomo hotiya ge hotiya gen i nunuwane-yan poniyene sohode i nunuwane-yan totone, ge vaini gen i hawatau-yan mwaniyene.

footnotes.text: Bwai heine lihu kakanun hotiya baptais lihuine.
